assessmentScope: Rechecked the registry's third-party ArcGIS Online SEDAPAL-derived layer and found/queried a separate Lotes layer on SEDAPAL's own GIS host.

officialCandidate.name: Lotes
officialCandidate.hostIdentity: Official SEDAPAL subdomain; ArcGIS REST service directly hosted under sedapal.com.pe
officialCandidate.primaryCatalogEvidence: National GeoIDEP institution listing labels a SEDAPAL Lotes WMS resource: https://www.geoidep.gob.pe/catalogo-nacional-de-servicios-web?id_institucion=221 (catalog page does not expose evidence that its WMS resource is the same MapServer/21 URL).

metadata.oid: OBJECTID; unique index, system-maintained transport ID
metadata.globalIdField: GLOBALID (GlobalID field type, but REST globalIdField/uniqueIdField unset)

requests.result: Layer metadata and schema; no copyright/license, edit date or designated GlobalID field.
5 San Juan de Lurigancho lots; unique GLOBALID and composite key values in sample; PROPERTYCODE and LASTUPDATE null; no owner fields requested.
Exact brace-wrapped GLOBALID lookup returned Polygon.
Exact district/square/parcel composite lookup returned same Polygon.
Unbounded count denied; this is endpoint access behavior, not evidence of source failure.
Stats request invalid; does not establish zero features.

officialCandidate.identityAssessment: GLOBALID field is the best exact-read candidate and its SQL lookup succeeds, but layer REST metadata leaves globalIdField/uniqueIdField null and FDO_GLOBALID index is marked non-unique; sample uniqueness only, no durable uniqueness contract. OBJECTID is a system-maintained row ID. District+square+parcel composite exact lookup returns one feature for tested sample but no unique composite index; PARCELCODE alone is a double and unsafe as ID. Avoid claiming citywide uniqueness.
officialCandidate.licenseEvidence: The official endpoint is on SEDAPAL's domain, but its own layer metadata publishes no reuse terms or copyright. Public query access is not a reuse grant.
officialCandidate.recommendation: HOLD for integration pending written reuse permission/terms and confirmation of identifier continuity/uniqueness. This official hosted source is a better publisher provenance lead than the registry's third-party copy but has incomplete service metadata and limited verified coverage.

registryThirdPartyCandidate.description: Vector file made by Consorcio Servicios Integrales under contract to SEDAPAL; based on SEDAPAL-provided mapping, field/office updated; 1:1,000.
registryThirdPartyCandidate.identity: No GlobalID field; OBJECTID is unique OID but system-maintained; candidate cod_dist+mza+lote fields nullable and no declared unique composite index.
registryThirdPartyCandidate.previousSample: Registry research dated 2026-09-29 showed three polygons in SJL and an empty central-Lima box; exact native composite was not freshly re-queried in this pass.
registryThirdPartyCandidate.recommendation: Do not use this third-party host as a substitute for the official SEDAPAL service; reuse rights and institutional account identity remain unresolved.
